name: Staff of Enchantment
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 196, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 493
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 196, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 493
Aura strong enchantment CL 13th
Slot none; Price 82,000 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
Often made from applewood and topped with a clear crystal, this staff allows use of the following spells:
Hideous laughter (1 charge)
Sleep (1 charge)
Suggestion (1 charge)
Crushing despair (2 charges)
Mind fog (2 charges)
Mass suggestion (3 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, crushing despair, hideous laughter, mass suggestion, mind fog, sleep, suggestion; Cost 41,000 gp
